note: Half-lives live in ../format_decay.json, not here (engine.terms has no attribute column). Every format listed here MUST have an entry there — the seed loader fails otherwise.

terms.label: News
terms.description: Time-bound announcement: openings, appointments, launches, updates.

terms.label: Event
terms.description: Announcement or preview of a dated happening. Hard-expires at the event's ends_at (§8.A) in addition to decaying.

terms.label: Offer
terms.description: Promotion or deal. Hard-expires at campaign.ends_at; never decays (§4).

terms.label: Review
terms.description: First-person evaluation of a venue, show, product or trip.

terms.label: Listing
terms.description: Roundup or listicle tied to a period ('New Restaurants in Jakarta 2024', 'Best brunches this month'). Series-deduped via series_key (§8.A).

terms.label: Guide
terms.description: Timeless how-to, thematic or area guide ('Where to eat in Senopati').

terms.label: Feature
terms.description: Long-form editorial not tied to a date.

terms.label: City guide
terms.description: Destination guide (Explore Indonesia, Discover Jakarta, World Traveller, Sites & Destinations).

terms.label: Opinion
terms.description: Column or op-ed. 148 legacy 'Opinion' articles have no §4 format; `feature` would misstate both their shape and their decay.
